entries.source: Awash in light Elvandar glistened, its circuitous faerie walkways decked in glowing lanterns of brushed gold and crystal. Above, a canopy of silver white leaves arched over the whole of the tree-top city, masking from view whether sun or moon reigned in the skies beyond.
entries.translation: 艾爾凡達沐浴在一片光芒中閃閃發亮，那些蜿蜒曲折的精靈步道上，掛滿了拉絲金與水晶製成的發光燈籠。頭頂上，一片銀白色的樹葉華蓋拱在整座樹冠之城上方，遮住了視線，教人看不出外頭的天空是由太陽還是月亮當家。

entries.source: "Gorath, isn't this the most perfect place you've ever seen?" Owyn exclaimed. "I've never dreamt of anything like this!"
entries.translation: 「戈拉斯，這是不是你這輩子見過最完美的地方？」歐文驚呼。「我作夢也沒夢過這樣的景象！」

entries.source: "Squire, if you can hold your tongue for a moment," Gorath said, "it might behoove you to bow to their Queen."
entries.translation: 「侍從，你要是能管住舌頭一會兒，」戈拉斯說，「向他們的王后行個禮，對你或許有好處。」

entries.source: Flushed with embarrassment Owyn turned heel, shriveling as he noticed the cloaked figures who waited patiently upon their thrones. Quickly he folded in obeisance, hoping sincerely that human manners would be appropriate in the elven court.
entries.translation: 歐文窘得滿臉通紅，轉過身，一看見那些披著斗篷、在寶座上耐心等候的身影，整個人都縮了起來。他連忙躬身行禮，真心盼著人類的禮數在精靈的宮廷裡也還算得體。

entries.source: "We have come from Krondor with news about Pug of Stardock," Owyn said. "We were in hopes..."
entries.translation: 「我們從克朗多趕來，帶著關於星塢島帕格的消息。」歐文說。「我們原本指望……」

entries.source: "Silence child." Queen Aglaranna spoke gently, her pale blue eyes glowing in the shadows. "Though we would hear of our dear friend, Pug, we first must attend to the unraveling of eons." Inclining her head towards Gorath, her voice and composure took on a grave edge. "You have come before us as a moredhel, but never may you leave Elvandar as such. Are you willing to return to us, your ancient kin, cousin?"
entries.translation: 「安靜，孩子。」亞葛拉蘭娜王后輕聲說道，她那雙淺藍色的眼睛在陰影中發著光。「儘管我們願意聽聽我們親愛的朋友帕格的事，但我們得先處理一樁綿延萬古的糾葛。」她朝戈拉斯偏了偏頭，聲音與神態染上一絲肅穆。「你以莫瑞德人的身分來到我們面前，卻絕不能以這身分離開艾爾凡達。你可願回到我們——你遠古的血親——身邊，表親？」

entries.source: Rage flashed in his eyes. Trembling with emotion Gorath advanced on the Queen, his hand darting to the hilt of his sword.
entries.translation: 他眼中怒火一閃。戈拉斯激動得渾身發顫，朝王后逼近，一手猛地按上劍柄。

entries.source: "No, Gorath!" Owyn gasped, knowing his voice was too small to stay his friend's wrath. "You can't!"
entries.translation: 「不要，戈拉斯！」歐文倒抽一口氣，心知自己的聲音太過微弱，攔不住朋友的怒火。「你不能這麼做！」

entries.source: "I was Gorath of the Clan Ardanien," he spat, his voice thick with an ageless contempt. Color drained from his face as he gripped ever more tightly the sword at his side. "I am Gorath and I formally return to the Eledehel and swear fealty to Aglaranna, Queen of Elves and to Tomas, Prince Consort and Warleader." Falling to one knee, he knelt low before Aglaranna's feet. "I am yours to command, lady."
entries.translation: 「我曾是阿爾達尼恩氏族的戈拉斯。」他啐道，聲音裡積著一股亙古的鄙夷。他臉上血色盡褪，握著腰間長劍的手越攥越緊。「我是戈拉斯，我正式歸返伊列德人，向精靈女王亞葛拉蘭娜、向王夫兼統帥托馬斯宣誓效忠。」他單膝一屈，深深跪伏在亞葛拉蘭娜腳邊。「聽憑您差遣，夫人。」

entries.source: His heart hammering an unsteady tattoo in his chest, Owyn stared in frank appraisal of the elves before him. Except for a glazed expression lingering on Prince Consort Tomas' face, he saw no evidence that any of them had witnessed anything unusual.
entries.translation: 歐文的心在胸口敲著一陣不穩的鼓點，他毫不掩飾地打量著眼前的精靈。除了王夫托馬斯臉上那抹揮之不去的呆滯神情之外，他看不出他們之中有誰目睹了什麼異常之事的跡象。

entries.source: "Rise. From this day forward, you are no longer moredhel, Gorath," Aglaranna said. "You are a member of the family of Elvandar and of the Eledehel. When your quest is done, you will return here to be one with us. That is our desire."
entries.translation: 「起來吧。從今天起，你不再是莫瑞德人了，戈拉斯。」亞葛拉蘭娜說。「你是艾爾凡達一族、是伊列德人的一員。等你的使命完成，你將回到這裡，與我們合為一體。這是我們的心願。」

entries.source: "What is this news of...Pug?" As if wakening from a dream, the elven Warleader spoke the magician's name with great concern, his dark eyebrows rising in interest as Owyn began to elaborate the details. At times he would request that certain details be repeated, but always his glassy eyes became sharply focused when Owyn spoke the names of Pug and members of Arutha's court.
entries.translation: 「關於……帕格的消息，究竟是什麼？」精靈統帥像是從夢中醒來，帶著極大的關切唸出那名法師的名字，歐文開始細說詳情時，他深色的眉毛饒有興味地揚了起來。他不時要求把某些細節重述一遍，但每當歐文提到帕格以及亞魯莎宮廷成員的名字，他那雙如玻璃般的眼睛總會驟然聚焦。

entries.source: "By the moons that means...trouble," Tomas coughed as the boy finished his tale. "The Book of Macros is not a book but instead a gift that Pug gave to me long ago. I was to use it to come to him if ever he left that message for me. I must go..."
entries.translation: 「憑諸月起誓，這意味著……麻煩。」男孩講完他的來歷時，托馬斯咳了一聲。「馬克羅斯之書並不是一本書，而是帕格很久以前送給我的一件禮物。若他哪天為我留下那則訊息，我就用它前去找他。我必須動身……」

entries.source: "You cannot, love. Even now I can sense the effects of the painkilling herbs beginning to wear off," Aglaranna said, laying a pale hand on Tomas' shoulder. As if broaching a delicate subject, she continued quietly. "Three days ago the Warleader was struck with a poisoned blade. Only last evening did his fever abate but he demanded to be brought here when he heard that a moredhel was returning. He hasn't the strength for the trip. You must go in his stead.
entries.translation: 「你不能去，我的愛。就是此刻，我也感覺得到那些止痛草藥的藥效開始退了。」亞葛拉蘭娜說著，一隻蒼白的手搭上托馬斯的肩。她像是在觸碰一個敏感的話題，輕聲說了下去。「三天前，統帥被一柄淬毒的刀刃所傷。直到昨晚他的高燒才退，可他一聽說有個莫瑞德人要歸返，便執意要人把他抬來這裡。他沒有力氣走這一趟。你必須代他前去。

entries.source: "Don't try my patience, Aglaranna. Pug needs my help and I shall go!" Struggling to gain his feet, he blanched with the effort, standing straight only by groping the back of his throne.
entries.translation: 「別考驗我的耐性，亞葛拉蘭娜。帕格需要我的幫助，我一定要去！」他掙扎著要站起來，使勁得臉色發白，全靠摸著寶座的椅背才勉強站直。

entries.source: "How many of our kin carried you here, my Warlord?" the Queen asked, her voice laced with concern. "Was it five or six? You are no longer possessed by the soul of Ashen-Shugar and you are not gifted with immortality! None doubt your strength or loyalty Tomas, but you owe it to Pug to send able help."
entries.translation: 「把你抬來這裡的族人有幾個，我的統帥？」王后問道，聲音裡摻著憂慮。「是五個，還是六個？灰燼舒加爾的靈魂已不再附於你身，你也沒有不朽之軀！沒有人懷疑你的力量或忠誠，托馬斯，可你欠帕格一份人情——派個得力的人去幫他。」

entries.source: "As always my love, you are wise," Tomas whispered, his strength beginning to fail him. Reaching beneath the seat of his throne, he brought forth a leather tome covered with dust...
entries.translation: 「一如既往，我的愛，你是明智的。」托馬斯低聲說道，力氣開始離他而去。他探手到寶座的坐墊底下，取出一本蒙著灰塵的皮革典冊……
